2608.05802.title: On-Policy Delta Distillation for Multilingual Math Reasoning
2608.05802.paper_summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is emerging as a promising alternative to reinforcement learning for LLM post-training, yet its effectiveness in multilingual settings remains underexplored. We study OPD and its advanced variant, On-Policy Delta Distillation (OPD$^2$), for mathematical reasoning in English, Korean, and Japanese. OPD$^2$ improves OPD by using the probability gap between a post-trained teacher and its base model as the learning signal. Experiments with Qwen3 show that OPD$^2$ consistently outperforms the original OPD, with particularly strong improvements in Korean and Japanese, and generally narrows the English-Korean performance gap. We further find that English-only OPD can also increase performance for Korean and Japanese, but often shifts the responses toward English, highlighting the importance of multilingual data to preserving target-language responses.
2608.05802.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）作為強化學習在大型語言模型後訓練中的一個有前景的替代方案時，其在多語言環境中的有效性仍然未被充分探索。我們研究了 OPD 及其進階變體，政策增量蒸餾（OPD$^2$），在英語、韓語和日語中的數學推理。OPD$^2$ 通過使用後訓練教師與其基礎模型之間的概率差距作為學習信號來改進 OPD。與 Qwen3 的實驗顯示，OPD$^2$ 一直優於原始的 OPD，尤其在韓語和日語中有顯著的改善，並且通常縮小了英語與韓語之間的性能差距。我們進一步發現，僅使用英語的 OPD 也可以提高韓語和日語的性能，但往往會使回應偏向英語，突顯了多語言數據在保護目標語言回應中的重要性。
